title: Coorg
subtitle: Madikeri · Abbey Falls · Talacauvery · Coffee Plantations
inclusions: Sleeper Class Train Tickets both ways (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Train Journey — Mumbai to Mangaluru
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Panvel Station. Reporting Time: 10:30 AM. Board train for Mangaluru. Overnight journey. 12 November 2026 (Thursday).

itinerary.title: Reach Mangaluru & Travel to Coorg
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Mangaluru Junction by 6:00 AM. Travel to Madikeri by Non-AC Bus (3 hrs). En-route breakfast. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. Evening at leisure. Dinner at hotel. 13 November 2026 (Friday).

Sightseeing places: Abbey Falls, Talacauvery Temple, Bagmandala, Raja Seat view point.

Note: Sightseeing sequence may vary as per on-time situations.

itinerary.title: Coorg Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Breakfast. Out for sightseeing. Dinner at hotel. 14 November 2026 (Saturday).

Sightseeing places: Dubare Elephant Camp, Golden Temple, Nisargdham Forest, Coffee Plantation Visit.

Note: Sightseeing sequence may vary as per on-time situations.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing & Return Journey
itinerary.description: Check-out from hotel. Breakfast at 8 AM. Visit Omkareshwar Temple. Travel to Mangaluru Junction Station. Train Boarding Time: 1:30 PM. 15 November 2026 (Sunday).

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by 10:45 AM. 16 November 2026 (Monday). Return home with sweet memories!
